summary: kaggle kernels push for QCC Phase 0: competition input not attached (v1 ERRORED with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'kickmix'); subsequent re-push hit 409 SaveKernel Conflict.
root_cause: kernel-metadata.json competition_sources used the user-prefixed form rikirinjani/google-verifiable-quantum-circuit-compilation, which the CLI silently rejects (it prints 'not valid competition sources and could not be added'). The bare slug google-verifiable-quantum-circuit-compilation is required. The 409 followed because v1 already existed and re-pushing with changed inputs conflicted; resolved by kaggle kernels delete then re-push.
